notes:
Executive summary: Stalled -> closed-lost to competitor. Aurora required PrivateLink (customer VPC to Redwood) and FIPS/KMS/HSM evidence for clinical data processing. Redwood Private roadmap included VPC/PrivateLink but delivery slipped; Aurora could not wait due to trial timelines.

Key quote: "We can’t delay the trial — our compliance team needs PrivateLink and KMS by end of Q1." — Head of Infrastructure (2026-01-18).

Technical evaluation highlights:
- POC (Nov 2025): ran embeddings and summarization on de-identified clinical notes in Redwood Dedicated. Performance/latency OK; cost projections acceptable.
- Security review (Dec 2025–Jan 2026): requested PrivateLink, proof of HSM-backed KMS, SOC2 audit copy and network flow logs retention policy.
- Engineering ask (Jan 2026): PrivateLink endpoints + customer-managed NAT + specific security posture for KV cache isolation. Redwood provided design doc but no ETA for PrivateLink GA.

Timeline (selected):
- 2025-11-04: Intro call (AE Sofia R.), POC scope agreed, Fireflies ff-20251104-intro.
- 2025-11-18: POC kickoff; SE Ethan ran sample workload using dedicated pool.
- 2025-12-12: Security questionnaire submitted; requested encryption + residency details. Drive: proposal-aurora-2025-11.pdf.
- 2026-01-18: Security call — customer reiterated PrivateLink requirement; committed to decision by end of Jan if networking supported. Fireflies ff-20260118-aurora-poc-call.
- 2026-02-02: Redwood PM update: PrivateLink pushed to roadmap Q3 2026. Aurora escalated to other vendors.
- 2026-02-18: Aurora selected alternative vendor with immediate PrivateLink support. AE updated CRM as closed-lost.

Sales notes / friction points:
- Champion risk: primary champion (Director of Data Science) moved teams during procurement; no clear successor advocating Redwood internally.
- Procurement insisted on contractual language around network isolation + audit log retention; Redwood template required legal review and longer cycles.
- Pricing not primary blocker; timeline + security was the decisive factor.

Next actions and follow-up plan:
- Marked closed-lost; set a 6–9 month re-engagement cadence tied to Redwood Private networking release notes.
- Action for AE: add to "vpc-blocked" lost reasons for postmortem and product feedback loop.
- Suggested exec handshake if roadmap accelerates; offer pilot access once PrivateLink is available.

Attachments / references: drive://redwood-deals/aurora/aurora-security-qa.pdf, INF-8742 (internal ask for PrivateLink spec), SEC-9921 (security evidence request).
